name: wb-starter
description: Starter motywu WordPress (Pinegrow 9.3 + Tailwind 4 + esbuild). Waybetter.

scripts.build: npm run css:build && npm run js:build && npm run webp
scripts.css:build: tailwindcss -i resources/css/main.css -o build/main.css --minify && tailwindcss -i resources/css/editor.css -o build/editor.css --minify
scripts.css:once: tailwindcss -i resources/css/main.css -o build/main.css && tailwindcss -i resources/css/editor.css -o build/editor.css
